purpose: A tool for busy professionals that turns a long email thread into a short catch-up and a suggested reply they can edit before sending.
target_audience: Anyone cc'd late into a long thread

thread_catchup.description: The user forwards or pastes a single email thread and gets back a concise catch-up of what has been decided and what is still open.
thread_catchup.example: A 40-message thread becomes five lines: three decisions, two open questions.

suggested_reply.description: From the same thread, produce a short draft reply in a chosen tone for the user to edit and send.

tone_choice.description: The user picks a tone (brief, warm, formal) for the draft.
